name: Net MIDI
description: Puts the Push's MIDI ports on the network as Apple MIDI (RTP-MIDI), so an iPad, iPhone or Mac sees the Push as a network MIDI peer: AUM lists it as Network Session 1. Live gets one port, Net MIDI, and a route table bridges other ports (Stacks, Riffs, ...) to the network. Configured on Push (the NETMIDI tab of the Shadow UI) and on its web page. Needs only push-manager; no display.
author: rgeissen
